[[Totality Tower|Solar Eclipse Event Night IV]] |first_wave_appearance = 9 ([[Totality Tower]]) |spawned_by = *[[Penumbras]] *[[Lunar Servant]] |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]550 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (2.5) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Crumbled}}''' - Upon death the '''Solar Shard''' spawns a [[Lunar Shard (Legacy)|Lunar Shard]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Solar Shard''' was an [[enemy]] that appeared in the third and fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It did not appear naturally in the [[Tower Outskirts]] and was instead spawned by [[Penumbras]], while in the [[Totality Tower]] it appeared naturally and could be spawned by the [[Lunar Servant]]. It had a low amount of health and a below average speed. Upon death the '''Solar Shard''' would spawn a [[Lunar Shard (Legacy)|Lunar Shard]]. ==Appearance== The '''Solar Shard''' had dark purple skin. It had a cracked torso, revealing a light orange substance within it. It had glowing orange shoulder-pads and a floating sun symbol behind its head. It walked with a slight hunchback. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS, such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]] are recommended to defeat this enemy. **You can also use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost these towers' firerate and range respectively. *If a '''Solar Shard''' has low health and is near the end of the map, try not to kill it, as it will transform into a [[Lunar Shard (Legacy)|Lunar Shard]] and do considerably more damage to the base. **However, the [[Lunar Shard (Legacy)|Lunar Shard]] will also turn into [[Dust]] upon death. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} SEthumbnail.png|'''Solar Shard''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Solar Shard''' on a promotional video. }} ==Trivia== *When the '''Solar Shard''' was killed, it would explode into a bunch of orange particles, however these are cosmetic and did not affect towers in any way. ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Solar Shard''' added. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in the [[Totality Tower]]. **Health increased from 400 to 550. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Solar Shard''' removed. {{TotalityTower|[[Vampire (Solar Eclipse)|Vampire]]|Wave 8|Solar Shard|Wave 9|[[Headless Jaxe]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Tower Outskirts]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Solar Shard}}
